ConnectionStrings._comment: Live production DB — same as the API / AwardsAutoCalcWorker. Uses localhost because the worker runs ON the server. For local testing, point it at the remote host (Server=localhost;...).

Interakt._comment: Same Interakt account as the API. ApiKey is the base64 value sent as 'Authorization: Basic <key>'.

Firebase._comment: Same Firebase service-account JSON the API uses. Deploy it next to the worker exe (ServiceAccountPath is relative to the exe dir) or set ServiceAccountAbsolutePath. If the file is missing, greeting push is disabled and WhatsApp/Email still send.

Greetings._comment: WhatsApp template names MUST be pre-approved in Interakt. The approved template is: 'Greetings from {{3}}, Dear Rtn. {{1}}, {{2}} ...' so bodyValues are sent in order [ {{1}}=member name, {{2}}=message body, {{3}}=club/district name ]. Same layout for birthday + anniversary (the occasion text is {{2}}); put the actual approved template name in each key below (the same name in both is fine if you use one template for both). The Default* text is used only when a club/district hasn't configured its own greeting text/subject.
Greetings.DefaultBirthdayMessage:
Wishing you a very happy birthday! 🎉

As you celebrate another year of togetherness, may your kindness continue to reach further and touch many lives.
Celebrate this special day by spreading hope through The Rotary Foundation.

🎁 Donate: https://my.rotary.org/en/donate

Brand._comment: ROW instance brand (Services/Brand.cs). Deployment values; set per server, e.g. Brand__PortalDomain.
